items.quote: 那魔王果信其言，立在龙床前面，大喝一声道：“那和尚是几时离了东土？唐王因甚事着你求经？”
三藏甚不过意，搀起那皇帝来，同入禅堂，又与八戒、行者、沙僧拜见了，方才按座。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""独立反向复核审计：西游记 第三十九回 [276325,284148)。

只读原文与候选，不写仓库。分节输出，每节可单独核对。
用法: python3 -B -s /tmp/cl-verify-xiyou-L1-0039/audit.py
"""
import json, hashlib, random, sys, re

ROOT = "/Users/carmen/Desktop/星系"
SRC  = ROOT + "/data/cache/a065244455cfb2221bcda94a.docs.json"
CAND = ROOT + "/loop/state/out/read_xiyou_L1_0039.candidate.json"
A, B = 276325, 284148
TASK_SRC_HASH = "c282cf39b2ae739a15a3efe4a0e83af546c525bcaad3bac6e21c9d6179a152a2"

def sha_file(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()

def quotes_of(cand):
    """递归收集所有 {quote,start,end,...} 节点。"""
    out = []
    def walk(o, path=""):
        if isinstance(o, dict):
            if isinstance(o.get("quote"), str) and "start" in o and "end" in o:
                out.append((path, o))
            for k, v in o.items():
                walk(v, path + "." + k)
        elif isinstance(o, list):
            for i, v in enumerate(o):
                walk(v, path + "[%d]" % i)
    walk(cand)
    return out

def uncovered(t, spans, a, b, th):
    m = []
    for s, e in sorted(spans):
        s, e = max(s, a), min(e, b)
        if e <= s: continue
        if m and s <= m[-1][1]: m[-1][1] = max(m[-1][1], e)
        else: m.append([s, e])
    un, prev = [], a
    for s, e in m:
        if s > prev: un.append((prev, s))
        prev = max(prev, e)
    if prev < b: un.append((prev, b))
    return [(s, e) for s, e in un if e - s >= th]

t    = json.load(open(SRC))[0]["text"]
cand = json.load(open(CAND))
seg  = t[A:B]
Q    = quotes_of(cand)

print("== 0. 源 / 区间 / 边界 ==")
print("src sha256           :", sha_file(SRC))
print("task sourceHash match:", sha_file(SRC) == TASK_SRC_HASH)
print("segment codepoints   :", len(seg), "| declared:", cand["source"]["codepoints"])
print("segment sha256       :", hashlib.sha256(seg.encode()).hexdigest())
print("declared segmentHash :", cand["source"]["segmentSha256"])
print("head                 :", repr(seg[:21]), "matches unitHead:",
      seg[:21] == cand["unitHeadCheck"]["headQuote"])
print("next chapter at end  :", t[B:B + 12] == "第四十回\u3000婴儿戏化禅心乱")

print()
print("== 1. 引用全量核验（%d 条实例）==" % len(Q))
bad = dict(verbatim=0, range=0, first=0, hash=0, occ=0)
for p, q in Q:
    s, e, txt = q["start"], q["end"], q["quote"]
    if not (A <= s < e <= B):        bad["range"] += 1
    if t[s:e] != txt:                bad["verbatim"] += 1
    if t.find(txt) != q.get("firstOccurrenceAt"): bad["first"] += 1
    if t.count(txt) != q.get("wholeTextOccurrences"): bad["occ"] += 1
    if q.get("sourceHash") != TASK_SRC_HASH: bad["hash"] += 1
print("failures:", bad)

print()
print("== 1b. 固定种子 20261010 抽 5 条 ==")
random.seed(20261010)
for p, q in random.sample(Q, 5):
    s, e = q["start"], q["end"]
    print("  %-34s find==start:%s slice==quote:%s occ:%d"
          % (p[:34], t.find(q["quote"]) == s, t[s:e] == q["quote"], t.count(q["quote"])))

print()
